evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Nicole: 'Hi, this is Nicole from Einstein nerving company. Am I speaking with Amy?' / Later: 'once again this is Nicole. Thank you so much for choosing Einstein. Moving take care. And you have a great day Amy.'
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: No time-boxed framing or dependable-quote promise delivered before committing to the walkthrough.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep jumped straight to walkthrough routing.
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: No Worries Damage Coverage ($2,000 per move, no deductible): 'we have no worries, damage coverage. We provide up to $2,000 per move. To repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages.' / On-Time Guarantee: 'we have on time guarantee. If we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.' Both delivered in recognizable form.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening: No concern-led opening like 'What items in this move are you most concerned about?' Logistics gathered included: moving date (Nov 3), packing request, square footage context (~1700), room count context (some empty rooms), special items (washer/dryer staying, books mentioned). Walking distance not confirmed, additional spaces (garage/shed) not probed.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Packing service asked and discussed extensively ('do you need us to pack your entire home or just partial packing'). Box count never asked.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not applicable to walkthrough routing; no pricing given.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Virtual walkthrough booked for Wednesday October 21st at 9:00 AM with link to follow. Moving dates confirmed: Monday Nov 2 (packing), Tuesday Nov 3 (move). Addresses confirmed (217 South Village Drive, McKinney TX 75072 to 5609 Edmont Drive, McKinney TX 75071). Phone (972-639-7225) and email (Amy@asquaredmedia.net) confirmed. Driveway parking confirmed for both. No crew size discussed or confirmed; no notes left about customer concerns.

top_strength: Nicole successfully routed the call to a virtual walkthrough, secured a confirmed appointment with date and time, and delivered both promises (damage coverage and on-time guarantee) before scheduling, providing full transparency on pricing structure, hourly rates, and materials costs.
coaching_note: Step 1 missing the quid pro quo entirely—the rep jumped straight into walkthrough routing without time-boxing the discovery, explaining what the walkthrough would accomplish, or getting an explicit yes before proceeding; Step 2 never asked the two-concerns question, which should have opened the discovery even on a walkthrough call; Step 3 did not close the loop with 'Does that put those to rest?' after delivering the promises; Step 4 lacked a concern-led opening and never asked about box count or walking distance details.
